# Timo Feddern | Projects

> Landing page and index of selected work by Timo Feddern, cloud fullstack developer at IBM Client Innovation Center Switzerland and master's student in Integrated Building Systems at ETH Zürich. Background: carpenter → digital construction specialist → cloud infrastructure. This site (git.feddern.dev) links out to the personal portfolio, academic and research projects, a study-guidance product, an event site, and an electronic-music label.

## Person

- **Name:** Timo Feddern
- **Role:** Cloud Fullstack Developer @ IBM CIC Switzerland
- **Education:** M.Sc. Integrated Building Systems, ETH Zürich (in progress)
- **Focus:** Cloud-native infrastructure (OpenShift, Kubernetes, Ansible, GitOps), digital construction (BIM, Rhino, Dynamo), privacy-focused decentralised networks
- **Location:** Zürich, Switzerland
- **Contact:** timo@feddern.dev

## Projects on this hub

- [Personal portfolio (feddern.dev)](https://feddern.dev): Terminal-style personal site with a live console. Details on work, background, featured GitHub repos.
- [HardLeaf](https://git.feddern.dev/ca2/): ETH Zürich Computational Architecture II studio project: a biomimetic timber pavilion optimising solar shading through vegetation. Interactive WebXR viewer with AR support.
- [Building Systems 1](https://git.feddern.dev/bs1/): ETH Zürich Building Systems 1 coursework: interactive 3D model viewer with AR support.
- [Bern Heat Islands](https://git.feddern.dev/smdldc/): interactive research guide on aerial imagery and modelled PET prediction.
- [StudyCompass](https://studycompass.ch): Product. A platform helping students find the study path that actually fits them.
- [GymRave](https://gymrave.ch): Event site. "Eine Rave. Im Gym." One-night rave at Sportcenter Ägeri on 25.09.2026 with T-Møse × NIRO.
- [Passabel Kollektiv](https://passabelk.ch): Independent electronic-music label organising rave events.

## Bern Heat Islands research

- [Research guide](https://git.feddern.dev/smdldc/): Bern modelled daytime physiological equivalent temperature (PET), not measured air or surface temperature. Includes original data reconstruction, 2021 and 2020 imagery investigations, height/water/shadow layers, classification/ordinal/regression comparisons and detailed error analysis.
- [Evaluation context](https://git.feddern.dev/smdldc/#evaluation-scope): reported experiments are development evaluations after repeated test-guided comparisons; independent final validation remains pending. Compare scores only with their target, mask, inputs, decoder, folds and seeds.
- [Sources and reuse](https://git.feddern.dev/smdldc/#credits): ©swisstopo and Geodaten Stadt Bern source terms remain applicable. No blanket Creative Commons licence or official-provider endorsement is asserted.
- [Privacy and site information](https://git.feddern.dev/privacy/): publisher contact, GitHub Pages/Cloudflare delivery and external resource information.

## Featured GitHub repositories

- [climatePlots](https://github.com/MisterEleven/climatePlots): Python toolkit for 8760-hour building environmental data: 20+ visualisation types including ASHRAE 55 thermal comfort (PMV/PPD).
- [EPW-upgrader](https://github.com/MisterEleven/EPW-upgrader): CLI + Python API that morphs EPW weather files toward projected climate scenarios (Belcher 2005, SSP5-8.5 / SSP2-4.5).
- [Gameserver-Operator](https://github.com/MisterEleven/Gameserver-Operator): Kubernetes-native operator for self-hosted game servers.
- [TASK-alavista](https://github.com/MisterEleven/TASK-alavista): Obsidian plugin that turns #schedule tasks into a local .ics for read-only Apple Calendar sync.
